contract: Five prose design questions with the pattern each must return.
Every question is worded as a predev design problem: no symbol, no package,
no operation, no class name, and no pattern name. A question naming its own
pattern would be answerable by string matching and would prove nothing.
Expected slugs are directory names in the pinned java-design-patterns fork.

questions.question: one of the services we depend on keeps going unresponsive and our retries are dragging the rest of the system down with it
we pick between several pricing algorithms with a chain of conditionals and need to swap them while the program runs
a single business transaction spans four microservices and we cannot use a two-phase commit
when one object changes state an unknown number of others need to hear about it without being tightly coupled to it
assembling this object takes many steps in a fixed order and we need different representations out of the same process
